The second bucket is gross margin expansion, and this is where you can really move the needle because every incremental dollar of gross margin flows almost directly to the bottom line. The mistake I see most often is companies defaulting to incremental maintenance capex without really questioning whether they're building new revenue streams or just maintaining legacy operations.
